object.attr: derived: CF-S22, D16. Figure files keep draw.io's document type declaration, so the refusal for data files can't apply to them, and a declared entity could still expand without bound when the figure is checked, drawn or exported. Decided on 2026-11-10.
object.description: If a figure file declares an entity, Mellon shall report a validation error naming the figure file, without expanding the entity.
